summary: Noah Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, which are a voting card and the depositary's notice for the annual general meeting (AGM) of shareholders scheduled for June 11, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance notification, instructing ADS holders on how to vote their shares. There are no special-situation events such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or management departure. The document is a standard AGM notice with no proposal outside ordinary business. This filing does not trigger any special-situation classification.
